Building

Announcements

Read important building notices and updates from Building Management.

How it works

Keep up with building information

Open an announcement to read the full notice, dates and instructions.

TENANT
1
Open Announcements
Click Announcements from the Building section.
📢 Click this menu item

Start with the announcement list

Active notices are shown first. Older notices can be opened from Archived.

Actual Redmyre BMS screen.
2
Choose a notice
Click the notice you want to read.

Look at the title, date and notice type

Urgent and maintenance notices are clearly marked so you can see what needs attention.

The actual list shows the notice title, date and status/type badge.
3
Read the full notice
The opened notice contains the full message, dates, times and instructions.

Check the details before you attend or respond

  • Scheduled date and time
  • What work or activity is taking place
  • Resident instructions and access information
Actual Redmyre BMS screen — opened announcement.

📌 Important

Read pinned or urgent notices first.

🗓️ Check dates

Notice dates and access times are shown in the full notice.

🔄 Keep checking

New notices can appear as building work changes.

Building

Resident Requests

Submit and track maintenance requests, complaints and service issues.

How it works

Submit and track your requests

Open a request to follow its progress from Open to Resolved.

TENANT
1
Click + New Request
Start a new request from the top of Resident Requests.
📬 + New Request

Choose what you need to report

Fill in the Category, Unit, Subject and Details. Add a photo or file when it helps explain the issue.

Actual Redmyre BMS screen — New Request form.
2
Choose Private or Public
The checkbox at the bottom changes who can see the request.

🔒 Private

Only you and Building Management can see and discuss the request.

🌐 Public

Other residents can see the request. The requester is shown anonymously as A Resident.

The actual Public checkbox is shown near the bottom of the request form.
3
Submit and follow the colour status
The request list uses words and colours so progress is easy to see.

Building Management responds within 24–48 hours during business days.

Actual Redmyre BMS screen — request status shown with colour.
🔴 Open
Submitted and still open.
🟡 In Progress
Being worked on by Building Management.
🟢 Resolved
The issue has been resolved.

A/C Temperature Request

Request a temperature adjustment for your floor.

How it works

Request a 0.5°C temperature adjustment

One request per 30 minutes — each adjustment changes the temperature by 0.5°C.

TENANT
1
Choose what the room needs
Use one of the two large A/C buttons.

The buttons tell you exactly what will happen

These are the same button images used by the live A/C Request page.

Temperature will be lowered by 0.5°C
Temperature will be raised by 0.5°C
2
Select your suite and press Submit Request
Choose the correct location, then submit the request.
Choose Lower / Raise→Choose Suite→Submit Request

The BMS sends the request through the Redmyre HVAC workflow.

Actual Redmyre BMS screen — buttons, locations, current setting and Submit Request.
3
The temperature is adjusted automatically
Each request changes the temperature by 0.5°C.
⏱️ One request every 30 minutes. The system applies a 0.5°C adjustment, then the next request can be made after the 30-minute limit.

This is a live HVAC control workflow — not just a message sent to Building Management.

4
Check My Requests
Open a request to see the temperature change and progress.
Submitted→Approved→Adjusted→Completed
Actual Redmyre BMS screen — completed adjustment with the status steps.

↕️ 0.5°C

Each adjustment moves the temperature by 0.5°C.

⏱️ 30 minutes

You can make another A/C request after 30 minutes.

🌡️ Live control

The request is connected to the Redmyre HVAC workflow.

Parking Management

Report and manage parking violations.

How it works

Report a parking violation

Report a parking violation and follow the incident on the page.

TENANT
1
Enter the number plate
Open Parking Management and enter the vehicle plate.

Then choose the parking location

Click the location button that matches where the vehicle is parked.

Actual Redmyre BMS screen.
2
Choose the violation type and add evidence
Click the matching violation type, then add a photo if needed.
  • Location: just click the correct location button.
  • Violation Type: click the correct type.
  • Photos are optional, up to 3.
  • Add a short comment when useful.
Actual Redmyre BMS screen — location, violation type, comments and photo controls.
3
Press Report Now
The report then appears under Active Incidents on the right.

You can also use Search Vehicle to check a number plate for owner/history information.

Actual Redmyre BMS screen — Active Incidents and Search Vehicle.

🏠 Registered resident vehicle

When a vehicle belongs to a registered resident, the BMS can send an automatic warning email telling the owner to move the vehicle.

Automatic emailPlease move your vehicle.

🚗 Visitor vehicle

A visitor vehicle has no resident contact details, so the first response is a warning sticker on the windscreen. From the 3rd violation, a red strong-adhesive sticker is used.

1–2Warning sticker3rd+Red strong-adhesive sticker

How it works

Understand the building temperature pattern

See where and when temperature requests are concentrated across the building.

TENANT
1
Read the building-wide A/C picture
This is an analysis dashboard using temperature requests from across Redmyre House.

2
See which floor has the most requests

Read Hot vs Cold and the monthly trend

📱 Install Redmyre BMS on Your Phone

Open the BMS quickly from your phone Home Screen like an app.

TENANT

🍎 iPhone / iPad

1

Open Redmyre BMS in Safari.

2

Tap the Share button.

3

Select Add to Home Screen.

4

Tap Add. Open BMS from the new icon.

🤖 Android

1

Open Redmyre BMS in Chrome.

2

Open the Chrome menu.

3

Select Add to Home screen or the install option shown.

4

Confirm and open BMS from the new Home Screen icon.

💡 You do not need to download a separate app from the App Store or Google Play.
